# The lobby's ruler designer buttons (gui/multiplayer_types.gui, generated by tools/make_lobby_designer_override.py).
# The engine designs only its own kinds of characters, so the Familial button designs a landless adventurer and marks
# the choice here; jip_familial_custom_family_start_on_action settles the designed adventurer as a family after the lobby

# The Familial button: the next designed adventurer becomes a family
jip_design_familial_house = {
	scope = character # the lobby's selected character
	effect = {
		set_global_variable = {
			name = jip_design_familial_house
			value = yes
		}
	}
}

# The adventurer button: a plain adventurer after all
jip_design_adventurer = {
	scope = character
	effect = {
		remove_global_variable = jip_design_familial_house
	}
}
